primitive.relation: one contract, upstream: GTMisc.X39.x39_separates_xy X Y A and Packing.X26.x26_separates_xy X Y Z (no simple sequence path from X to Y, B5's seq_set_path, has its vertex set, B1's seq_vertices, disjoint from the separator) are transparent aliases of GraphTheory.core.connectivity.separator G X Y A (every packaged Path from a vertex of X to a vertex of Y meets A), with argument order G, X, Y, separator and G implicit as before. GTBase.set_separators.seq_separatorP proves the frozen sequence bodies equivalent without any premise: upstream separatorI reduces arbitrary packaged paths to irredundant ones, whose node lists are set-to-set simple paths (seq_set_path_nodes, seq_vertices_nodes), and every such sequence packages as a Path with the same vertices (Path_of_path, mem_path, nodesE). Nothing restricts X, Y or the separator: endpoints may lie in it, one-vertex paths count, so every common vertex of X and Y lies in it (separator_seq1, upstream separator_cap), and empty endpoint sets are separated by anything. No second predicate, guard or base re-export is introduced. Distinct and untouched: upstream separates x y U, which also requires both endpoints outside U (separator_not_separates), Cycle's multigraph edge separator ueseparates, global vertex cutsets and balanced separators, Digraph dicuts, disjoint path collections and X116's inline hitting clause.

set-to-set-separator.note: upstream separator G X Y A over packaged paths, endpoint hits allowed and one-vertex paths counted; the frozen sequence bodies are equivalent through the unconditional seq_separatorP. X39's ball row, the cross-module X40 distance-2 row (partial) and X26's bounded-degree row are frozen over it with every guard and quantifier order, and B5's complete X39Original, X40Original and X26Original rows (raw support, set path and separator; balls live at this pin) are reused end to end. The incoming A22 raw-ball Originals are a combined-parent obligation, not claimed here. The final B26 integration also registers the actual A22 balls.X39Original, X40Original and X26Original complete rows over raw B1 supports, B5 paths/separators and A22 balls. Earlier per-family copies and all their frozen bodies remain unchanged; the deepest existing A22 whole proofs explicitly reuse the adapted B5 separator bridges.

upstream_audit.note: coq-graph-theory's connectivity.v defines separator (G : diGraph) A B S := every packaged Path from A to B has a vertex in S, with separatorI (irredundant paths suffice) and separator_cap (A :&: B lies in S), and the different separates x y U (x and y both outside U, and every Path from x to y meets U). Both migrated wrappers are separator at an sgraph, so the canonical is upstream; GTBase.set_separators adds only the sequence bridge seq_separatorP and corner lemmas, defines no predicate and is not re-exported by GTBase.base.
